label: Parse Document
description: Turn a PDF, scan, or image into clean markdown through Mistral's OCR (tables, layout, 100+ languages). Emits the whole document's markdown and a per-page breakdown as stored files, since a long document weighs more than the 100 KB a wire carries: wire `markdown` into a File to Text node to read a short one as text.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Mistral access (wire a MistralAccess node).

outputs.name: markdown
outputs.description: A markdown file (`text/markdown`) holding the whole document, its pages one after another.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: A JSON file holding a list with one entry per page: `index` (from 0) and `markdown`.
